A heftruckchauffeur at Coca-Cola works a three shift schedule, so get ready for a whole bunch of shift allowances!

The front office consists of reception and our Coffee & Bakery, where we sell coffee, fresh bread and a small range of groceries. This is a seasonal role from 1 March to 1 October. Working until 1 September is also possible for candidates who go back to school after that. - You are the first point of contact for our guests, at the desk, by phone and by email. - You process reservations in the booking system. - You carry out various administrative tasks. - You give guests information about the park and the area. - You sell products from the Coffee & Bakery, merchandise and souvenirs.
